summary: Learn to design valid experiments, read results with confidence, and improve conversion. Join TrainingCred’s practical 5-day course.
lede: A/B testing and business experimentation creates a structured way to compare digital experiences or business processes and identify which produces the stronger measured outcome. This course develops the practical skills to form clear hypotheses, select primary and guardrail metrics, plan traffic and sample needs, and interpret results without overclaiming. You will use pre-test analysis, minimum detectable effect planning, confidence interval thinking, power-aware sample sizing, and post-test decision rules to build a repeatable testing workflow. The course also introduces multivariate testing, session replay analysis, and experiment prioritization so you can turn reliable findings into an evidence-based experimentation backlog.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, run, analyze, or govern A/B testing and business experimentation programs across digital products and growth channels.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of digital analytics concepts such as conversion rate, traffic sources, events, and basic reporting dashboards. Familiarity with website or product metrics is helpful, and no coding is required to complete the course. If your team uses an experimentation platform, analytics tool, or product analytics dashboard, bringing example reports or sanitized test data will make the practical exercises more relevant. Advanced statistical concepts will be taught at an operational level, with sample size, significance, and confidence explained in applied business terms.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
